title: Hugging Face CEO Criticizes Netflix AI Documentary
excerpt: Clem Delangue warns that the Netflix film 'AI Gone Rogue' is inaccurate and adopts an overly alarmist tone.
body_html:
Clem Delangue, the co-founder and CEO of Hugging Face, has raised concerns regarding the accuracy of a new Netflix documentary titled "AI Gone Rogue." Delangue, who appears in the film, advised viewers to reconsider sharing or accepting the documentary's portrayal of artificial intelligence.

According to the Hugging Face executive, the project adopted an extreme approach, which he described as going "full doomer mode." He stated that the production failed to present an accurate representation of the situation involving the OpenAI hack and the broader context of the technology discussed.

The documentary, which centers around security concerns and artificial intelligence, features industry figures but has now drawn direct criticism from one of its own participants over its tone and factual alignment.
